title: 现有樟树透明图的可见根干接地基准
notice: 像素与模型显示接地的修正，不是树木测绘；原图、树木位置、高度、数量及地形数据保持不变。

selection.method: Widest contiguous alpha >= shader cutoff run in the original bottom 2 percent; lowest row wins ties
selection.textureCoordinates: Pixel centers; v=1 is image top

displaySelection.note: Source point records are retained. Only exact source tuples with a documented displayed geometry conflict are omitted from the tree batch.

geometryContract.horizontal: (u - anchorUv[0]) * 2 * halfWidth; all three trunk centers share the original tree point
geometryContract.vertical: quadBaseLocalZ = min(local terrain Z at the 21 contact samples) - height * anchorUv[1] - embedMeters
geometryContract.terrain: createYichangTerrain.surfaceHeightAt: decoded highest-available provider triangle mesh, including height quantization, queried after the same ENU transform

flatTerrainAudit.method: Pixel-center comparison on a constant-height terrain, before tile quantization or minification

limitations: Pixel-derived contact is a display correction, not a surveyed root shape.
The tree card shape, height, image colors, source alpha and all 2599 point records are retained.
Contact uses the provider triangle reconstruction, not the smoother native bilinear source grid. Coarser visible LOD may differ.
On steep DSM-derived slopes, the higher ground naturally hides more of the lower trunk.
The fixed source hash requires a new audit if the cutout image is replaced.
